summary: postcss-motion-utils ships obfuscated bytecode-VM payload as module main
details: Package is advertised as a small PostCSS plugin that injects CSS variables and adds -webkit- prefixes, but its `main` (index.js) is a 164 KB single-file Bun-bundled artifact wrapped in a bytecode-VM obfuscator: a rotated string array (`vmZ`) with a shift-based decoder, a VM interpreter (`vmT_21dbca`), and a payload table of ~20 large base64 blobs, several of which decode to opaque binary-shaped bytes. The file begins with the `// @bun` header and a `while(!![])` string-array rotation loop. Because this file is the module main, the VM and its embedded payloads execute on `require('postcss-motion-utils')`. The declared PostCSS functionality does not require bytecode-VM obfuscation or embedded binary blobs; the shape (opaque decoder + rotated string array + base64-encoded inner payloads executed at import) matches the structure of hidden supply-chain payloads rather than a CSS utility library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
